recipe_contract.objective: Create an abandoned native host guard with an unresolved durable fence; only reviewed reconciliation may proceed and the lock is never stolen.
Hold the authorized host guard on the first operation while a contender attempts an overlapping stage.
Observe an Ubuntu 24.04 WSL2 target meeting owner, user, startup, quiesce and nonsensitive adoption preconditions.
Observe an eligible ADOPT_NONSENSITIVE source together with its ISO-external restore prerequisites.
Arrange a valid approval that expires across the reviewed reboot or resume boundary without changing completed mutation state.
Observe complete mandatory and optional evidence inputs for the selected bundle scope with clean redaction preconditions.
Tamper one copied bundle manifest or member hash after safe bundle material exists; preserve original evidence separately.
Arrange a controlled C3 process or controller crash after pre-C3 protection is sealed, retaining unresolved fence and recovery material.
Arrange a C3 candidate whose pre-existing protection or postcheck prerequisites are incomplete or invalid so mutation cannot begin.
Alter a disposable copy of trusted checkpoint bytes after reference sealing; never alter the backup of record.
Observe a CLEAN_P00 source quiesced and stopped with bound critical manifest, provenance and checkpoint prerequisites.
Observe target plus declared non-target resources and owner-safe health/content assertion references.
Arrange an existing name/path collision or schema-safe malicious path input inside the disposable namespace; no path escape is performed.
Arrange an overlapping request or crash boundary that retains guard/fence uncertainty for reconciliation.
After protection sealing, arrange a source write or material change that invalidates the bound source witness.
Observe a supported host/runtime with the intended CREATE target name/path absent and the target parent eligible.
Hold the host guard with a different approved route or target while a contender attempts a cross-scope operation.
Hold the host guard under one legitimate owner SID while a contender uses another reviewed SID context.
Observe SITE C0 facts for an explicit target while guest eligibility remains unknown and requires active discovery.
Observe a supported preprofile where packaged WSL/runtime prerequisite is absent and the expected postprofile is pinned.
Observe clean-host ENGINE prerequisites including no pre-existing reboot and management-recovery readiness.
Arrange one mandatory evidence or bundle failure while preserving bounded safe failure diagnostics.
Arrange an existing target that requires pre-C3 checkpoint/protection before host restart.
Arrange a prior entry/runtime failure with safe blocker evidence but no apply-result, bound to FAILED_RUN scope.
Arrange the GATE_HANDOFF bundle/assessment boundary with E16/E17 separation and no self-hash prerequisite.
Change a declared shared/global policy fact after plan binding; never weaken the policy to make the test pass.
Change an isolated-restore NIC, share or device fact after attestation and before import.
Omit one mandatory pre-boot isolation proof or mapping condition before restore import.
Inject journal storage I/O failure at a reviewed persistence boundary while retaining the original fence.
Fail the mutation-completion journal append after native completion, preserving uncertainty and blocking the next step.
Constrain mandatory evidence output or aggregate cap so a required semantic record cannot complete.
Make one mandatory collector unavailable or timed out under a bounded fixture.
Observe the exact supported live host/runtime/config profile matching the plan and authenticated catalog key.
Change one material host, target or config fact after plan binding and before entry or verification.
Arrange lifecycle state where a required activation or restart epoch witness is absent or inconsistent.
Combine optional and mandatory evidence failures with a residual synthetic secret so privacy precedence is exercised.
Arrange a controlled native-child timeout while process outcome remains uncertain and the durable fence is retained.
Insert synthetic secrets into nested or encoded test-evidence fields for redaction validation.
Change network boundary or context between plan/initial observation and terminal verification.
Arrange reviewed Windows and guest endpoint contexts to exercise DNS/TCP/TLS/HTTPS without security relaxation.
Cause a bounded DNS, TCP, TLS or HTTPS failure in the test network context without disabling TLS or firewall policy.
Constrain optional evidence output beyond its cap while mandatory evidence remains complete.
Make one optional collector unavailable or timed out while mandatory inputs remain valid.
Inject atomic output/publication failure after safe collection without printing raw fallback data.
Omit or deny one required affected-resource owner postcheck after C3.
Observe a stopped or unknown guest under passive C0 without launch and preserve REQUIRES_ACTIVE_PROBE.
Submit a schema-valid path, symlink or escape request to the evidence path boundary and reject before secret reads.
Arrange an approved ENGINE transition followed by CREATE with exact pre- and post-profile expectations.
Crash after distro registration is observed but before ownership, user or workspace completion; retain identity and fence.
Observe inventory scope before target creation with guest NOT_YET_CREATED and no gate promotion.
Omit a mandatory target or affected-resource pre-C3 protection element so C3 blocks before mutation.
Provide a SITE qualification fixture with one reviewed invalid state: FAIL, withdrawn, gate blocker or expiry.
Provide an otherwise valid SITE qualification with one exact design/build/test/profile/payload scope mismatch.
Provide SITE active-entry probe overlays with no qualification receipt or qualification ref.
Arrange a route reaching the approved owner reboot or OOBE wait with durable checkpoint and fence.
Arrange protection or recovery proof located in or dependent on the WSL runtime being changed.
Leave one synthetic canary or unallowlisted raw field after sanitizer execution to require privacy blocking.
Observe exact LAB registration/controller mode with disposable, no-real-credentials and no-production-mappings containment.
Arrange boundary resource observations around approved minimum and capacity thresholds without exhausting the real host.
Arrange one approved resource floor below threshold in a disposable test context.
Arrange a bounded restore import or verify failure against a disposable checkpoint or clone while preserving the original.
Arrange retained clone bytes so measured free capacity falls below a later required reserve.
Arrange a same-host restore request whose source lacks clean provenance or startup guarantees.
Arrange source classification SENSITIVE, UNKNOWN or nonconsented so export/import rejects before data movement.
Arrange multiple approved targets or allocations sharing one volume so retained bytes affect later admission.
Use SITE registration/context while attempting a LAB class or mode claim and require identity/class rejection.
Arrange source and destination restore sequence under one host guard with an immutable checkpoint link.
Stage a reviewed config change that remains inactive until lifecycle restart and prove the pre/post epochs.
Arrange terminal sweep or assessment timestamps beyond reviewed freshness while retaining the actual recorded time.
Arrange normal target stop/start and planned host restart lifecycle with content and sentinel baseline.
Arrange the explicit target stopped at start with startup behavior known; passive observation must not launch it.
Arrange a synthetic isolated restore source that attempts egress or out-of-surface write using no real endpoint or credential.
Arrange one invalid or missing trusted artifact, pin, signature or content condition at the entry boundary.
Provide a forged or unsupported qualification/trust artifact in an isolated entry probe without changing primary authority.
Provide an observed/profile-catalog combination outside the supported binding so entry blocks.
Submit a mutation-purpose request through a verify boundary and require purpose-separation rejection.
Use a disposable host/capability fixture where virtualization prerequisite is observed false or blocked; never change user BIOS or site firmware.
Run the entry probe under a principal different from the plan and registration owner inside a controlled overlay.
